tour_seo_low.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_low.text: *At the noisy end of the lunchtime hallway, I run into Seoyeon. She readjusts her grip on the bag strap and steps half a pace aside without a sound.* Let's look around separately today. I still have papers to sort in the student council room.

tour_yuna_low.name: Yuna
tour_yuna_low.text: *Not long after I stop in front of the firmly locked annex door, a short message from Yuna pops up on my phone.* I want to be alone today. *I glance once at the cold, shut handle, then turn and walk back out into the hallway.*

tour_dain_low.name: Dain
tour_dain_low.text: *I run into Dain at the gym entrance. A volleyball tucked under her arm, she turns toward the inside of the court, avoiding my eyes.* Sorry. I need to practice alone today. See you later.

tour_seo_1.name: {name}
tour_seo_1.text: *Seoyeon and I stop side by side in front of the school gate, lunch sunlight pouring down. This is the exact spot where she stood on the morning of my first day, waiting for me when I was nervous.*

tour_seo_2.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_2.text: *She looks up at the gate pillar, a faint smile at the corner of her mouth.* We said hello here for the first time, didn't we.

tour_seo_3.name: {name}
tour_seo_3.text: It was my first day after transferring, and you have no idea how nervous I was. Standing in front of you, my head went blank. I didn't know what to say first.

tour_seo_4.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_4.text: *She glances back at me, a playful look in her eyes.* Were you? On the outside you looked perfectly calm, greeting me properly every time. ...Actually, I've been watching you ever since then.

tour_seo_5.name: {name}
tour_seo_5.text: ...From the school gate, on the first day?

tour_seo_6.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_6.text: *Her earlobes flush red, and she turns her eyes to the distant sky for no reason.* ...Well, you might have misheard that just now, because of the wind.

tour_seo_7.name: {name}
tour_seo_7.text: *The festival banner above the gate hangs perfectly still. There isn't a breath of wind.*

tour_seo_8.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_8.text: Hey, this looks a lot like the rooftop key, doesn't it? There's no real groove cut into the end, though. *Seoyeon takes a silver metal key ring from her pocket and holds it out on her palm.*

tour_seo_11.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_11.text: It's a student council souvenir from this festival. The real rooftop key I had has to go back to the administration office once today's events are over.

tour_seo_12.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_12.text: Don't lose it. Keep it safe. *As she hands me the key ring, the tips of Seoyeon's warm fingers brush long across my palm. Startled, she pulls her hand back and grips her bag strap tight.*

tour_seo_13.name: {name}
tour_seo_13.text: After you return the key, how do we get up to the roof from next week?

tour_seo_14.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_14.text: *Seoyeon steps closer and looks straight up into my eyes.* You can just tell me. Then, instead of sneaking up, we borrow the key properly and open it together.

tour_seo_freetalk.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_freetalk.text: *After we walk once around the schoolyard lined with festival booths, we climb the familiar stairs and open the rooftop door. Seoyeon rests her hand quietly on the sun-warmed railing.* Even at lunch on the school festival day, this is still where the two of us end up.

tour_seo_end.name: {name}
tour_seo_end.text: *The moment I pocket the souvenir key ring Seoyeon gave me, the real rooftop key she hasn't returned yet clinks, a clear metal sound, inside her bag as the wind shifts it.*

tour_yuna_1_check.name: {name}
tour_yuna_1_check.text: *I leave the lunchtime bustle behind and head for the library annex.*

tour_yuna_1.name: {name}
tour_yuna_1.text: *Lazy afternoon sunlight stretches long across the quiet annex window. The old velvet sofa and the smell of aged paper dust wrap around me, just as they did on the first day.*

tour_yuna_1b.name: {name}
tour_yuna_1b.text: *Clear afternoon sunlight settles warmly over the annex's old sofa, where we sat shoulder to shoulder and read together.*

tour_yuna_2.name: Yuna
tour_yuna_2.text: *Yuna, sitting by the window, looks up at the sound of my steps and taps the seat right beside her twice with her palm.* Come sit here. I dusted this spot already, so there's no dust.

tour_yuna_3.name: {name}
tour_yuna_3.text: *When I sit beside Yuna, the edge of my shoulder lightly touches hers.* It's strange. Once I step through this door, the festival noise from the field falls away, like it was never there.

tour_yuna_4.name: Yuna
tour_yuna_4.text: *Yuna tilts her head a little and looks into my face.* ...You meant that in a good way?

tour_yuna_5.name: {name}
tour_yuna_5.text: Yeah. In the sense that it's just right for the two of us to catch our breath.

tour_yuna_6.name: Yuna
tour_yuna_6.text: *A very faint smile spreads at the corner of Yuna's mouth. She takes a new notebook from her bag and sets it on her lap.* I cleaned up the sentences I'd been writing and copied them neatly into a new notebook. The revision marks are still there beside them, so the margins are a little messy.

tour_yuna_7.name: Yuna
tour_yuna_7.text: ...And I finally wrote all the way through to the ending.

tour_yuna_8.name: {name}
tour_yuna_8.text: Really? How does it feel, now that you've written all the way through a story you held onto for so long?

tour_yuna_9.name: Yuna
tour_yuna_9.text: *Yuna's eyelashes tremble slightly as she brushes a hand down the notebook cover.* I don't know... If I say it's the end out loud, it feels like the time I was sharing with you closes there too. It's a little strange.

tour_yuna_10.name: Yuna
tour_yuna_10.text: Here. ...Ah, the corner caught a little on the lining of the bag. *Yuna carefully pulls the notebook free and holds it out to me with both hands. The fingertips wrapped around it are trembling, just barely.*

tour_yuna_11.name: {name}
tour_yuna_11.text: Is it okay if I'm the first reader of this notebook?

tour_yuna_freetalk.name: Yuna
tour_yuna_freetalk.text: *Yuna slowly runs a slender finger down the spine of the new notebook, then quietly lifts her head.* ...I talked a lot more than usual today, didn't I.

tour_yuna_end.name: Yuna
tour_yuna_end.text: The first reader of this ending. ...I left that place open for you from the start.

tour_yuna_end_2.name: {name}
tour_yuna_end_2.text: *Yuna stops there and rests her gaze on the notebook in my hands. The quiet of the annex fills with the sound of two heartbeats.*

tour_dain_1_check.name: {name}
tour_dain_1_check.text: *I head toward the gym, full of lunchtime energy.*

tour_dain_1.name: {name}
tour_dain_1.text: *Beside the white court line where Dain and I made our bet on the first day, the volleyball rack we tidied side by side last night sits in a neat row. The gym lights, bright as midday, shine on the court floor.*

tour_dain_1b.name: {name}
tour_dain_1b.text: *On the ceiling of the gym I just walked into, every light is on bright today, of all days.*

tour_dain_2.name: Dain
tour_dain_2.text: You're here! Today I don't want to sweat and hit a ball. I just want to hang around with you. You're not heading back to the classroom already, are you? *Dain tucks a volleyball lightly under her arm and waves brightly from the middle of the court.*

tour_dain_3.name: Dain
tour_dain_3.text: *She strides right up in front of me, eyes bright.* Hey, want to play one more round of rock-paper-scissors right here?

tour_dain_4.name: {name}
tour_dain_4.text: Pretty confident for someone who's just going to lose to me again.

tour_dain_5.name: Dain
tour_dain_5.text: Ha, my gut's different today. This time I'm winning, no question!

tour_dain_6.name: {name}
tour_dain_6.text: *Rock, paper, scissors, shoot. — Dain's scissors stop limp in front of my fist.*

tour_dain_7.name: Dain
tour_dain_7.text: ...Ah, seriously, why do I only ever lose to you!

tour_dain_8.name: Dain
tour_dain_8.text: ...Hey, don't laugh like that! *Dain frowns like it's unfair, but she can't hold the laugh that slips out. She breaks into a soft laugh and sets the volleyball down on the court.*

tour_dain_10.name: Dain
tour_dain_10.text: *She looks quietly down at the white line on the court and speaks in a voice that has grown much calmer.* ...Honestly, I still don't really know if I can make it all the way to the pro stage.

tour_dain_11.name: {name}
tour_dain_11.text: *The volleyball she set down rolls slowly along the white end line. I stay quietly beside her, without rushing, until she says the next thing she's been holding in.*

tour_dain_11_b.name: Dain
tour_dain_11_b.text: I used to think that if one volleyball dropped out of my life, I'd be left as nothing but an empty shell. But... after I met you, that started to change.

tour_dain_12.name: Dain
tour_dain_12.text: I can't put into words exactly what changed, but now even when I walk off the court, I keep finding things I want to say to you.

tour_dain_end.name: Dain
tour_dain_end.text: *Dain lifts her head, looks me straight in the eye, and smiles brightly.* Of course. I'm not left standing out there alone off the court anymore.

tour_dain_freetalk.name: Dain
tour_dain_freetalk.text: *She lightly pins, under the sole of her sneaker, a volleyball that rolled up to her toes.* It's lunch on festival day, for once. It'd be a shame for us to split up like this.

tour_dain_end_2.name: {name}
tour_dain_end_2.text: *Instead of rubbing the knee that hurt, Dain rests her palm quietly on the leather of the volleyball and rolls the ball gently to my feet.*

tour_co_event_1.name: {name}
tour_co_event_1.text: *The bell for lunch rings out, but the serving line is shorter than usual. In the messy hallway, all that's left is the dry clatter of someone opening and closing a lunchbox lid alone.*

tour_co_event_2.name: {name}
tour_co_event_2.text: *An ownerless festival staff vest hangs limp over the back of an empty chair. No one says out loud whose seat it was.*

tour_co_seo_1.name: {name}
tour_co_seo_1.text: *The rooftop door is half open, but Seoyeon doesn't walk out toward the railing the way she usually does. She stands with her back leaning at an angle against the steel doorframe.*

tour_co_seo_2.name: Seoyeon
tour_co_seo_2.text: I just returned the rooftop key to the administration office. ...Let's leave lunch here for today.

tour_co_seo_3.name: {name}
tour_co_seo_3.text: *As Seoyeon turns toward the stairs, the corner of her clipboard hits the steel doorframe with a dull sound. She goes down without stopping once.*

tour_co_yuna_1.name: {name}
tour_co_yuna_1.text: *Yuna sits at the end of the annex sofa and never opens the notebook on her lap. She only winds her bag strap tight around her pale fingers and lets it loose, over and over.*

tour_co_yuna_2.name: Yuna
tour_co_yuna_2.text: ...The ending on the last page of the notebook. I don't want to show it today.

tour_co_yuna_3.name: {name}
tour_co_yuna_3.text: *Afternoon sunlight seeping through the window stretches all the way to the empty seat beside me, but Yuna never closes the distance.*

tour_co_dain_1.name: {name}
tour_co_dain_1.text: *The lights on the gym ceiling are glaringly bright, but every volleyball that should be rolling across the court is locked inside the rack.*

tour_co_dain_2.name: Dain
tour_co_dain_2.text: Rock-paper-scissors... let's do it next time. Sorry. Today I just want to rest alone.

tour_co_dain_3.name: {name}
tour_co_dain_3.text: *Out of habit, Dain yanks the end of her wrist wrap hard, then lets go without strength and drops her gaze.*

tour_seo_event_1.name: Haeun
tour_seo_event_1.text: *Out of breath, Haeun runs down the hallway and stops.* President! The broadcast club rehearsal in the auditorium overlaps with the field booth safety check. Should I go to the broadcast room instead?

tour_seo_event_2.name: {name}
tour_seo_event_2.text: *Seoyeon's hand moves to adjust her grip on the clipboard, then stops short. With the tip of her pen, she taps the "broadcast rehearsal" box on the schedule twice, lightly.*

tour_seo_event_3.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_event_3.text: All right. You handle the broadcast room, Haeun. When you're done, just tell me briefly if anything comes up.

tour_seo_event_4.name: Haeun
tour_seo_event_4.text: *Haeun's eyes go round, then curve bright.* Yes! But you can't sneak over halfway through just because you're worried!

tour_seo_event_5.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_event_5.text: *Until Haeun's energetic back turns the corner, Seoyeon doesn't chase after her in worry. A lighter breath brushes the corner of her mouth.* ...Right. The world won't fall apart just because one thing doesn't pass through my own hands.

tour_yuna_event_1.name: {name}
tour_yuna_event_1.text: *When we step out into the hallway in front of the annex, two juniors stand side by side at the literature club display board. Pointing at the short story Yuna posted without a name, they whisper about where they can read what comes next.*

tour_yuna_event_2.name: {name}
tour_yuna_event_2.text: *Once the juniors leave, Yuna quietly steps up to the board and touches a corner of the manuscript. The fingertips that were about to peel the paper off, out of habit, stop just under the title.*

tour_yuna_event_3.name: Yuna
tour_yuna_event_3.text: *She turns slightly toward me and whispers, low.* ...There isn't a next part yet, but at least I wrote this.

tour_yuna_event_4.name: {name}
tour_yuna_event_4.text: *Yuna takes a pale purple fountain pen from her pocket and writes the three characters of her name in the blank space under the title. "Choi Yuna." Because her fingertips are shaking, the last character leans just a little to the right.*

tour_yuna_event_5.name: Yuna
tour_yuna_event_5.text: *Yuna caps the fountain pen, turns from the display, and walks back into the annex. A low, ticklish voice settles by my ear as she passes.* ...The real ending, I'll show it to you first. Before anyone else.

tour_dain_event_1.name: {name}
tour_dain_event_1.text: *In a corner of the gym, Dain's phone rings for a long time. After she checks the coach's name, she listens in silence all the way through as he asks whether she can play even briefly in the afternoon festival exhibition match.*

tour_dain_event_2.name: Dain
tour_dain_event_2.text: *Dain looks at me once, then speaks in a steady voice.* Coach, I'm not playing in today's exhibition match. I told Mom myself this morning, too. But if the commentary mic at the officials' booth is open, I'll take that!

tour_dain_event_3.name: {name}
tour_dain_event_3.text: *A little later, Dain climbs to the second-floor commentary booth and taps the microphone. Her clear voice carries over the court spread out below.*

tour_dain_event_4.name: Dain
tour_dain_event_4.text: Here we go, first serves from both teams! No chance. That ball was exactly inside the line! Complaints about the call, I'll take them after the match, in front of the snack shop, if you bring ice cream!

tour_dain_event_5.name: Dain
tour_dain_event_5.text: *Under the laughter and applause pouring up from below the booth, Dain switches off the microphone and catches her breath, light, as she comes down the stairs.* ...Even without running on the court myself, I have this much I can say. It's a lot more fun than I thought.

tour_seo_affinity_80.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_affinity_80.text: *Seoyeon opens her diary a little and shows me a page.* I left the first slot on my schedule for next week open. You pick the time for wherever we go.

tour_seo_affinity_60.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_affinity_60.text: When the afternoon events are all done, let's stop by the rooftop for a bit. Today I'll go up first and wait, before you get there.

tour_yuna_affinity_80.name: Yuna
tour_yuna_affinity_80.text: I'll save the first-reader seat in the next notebook for you, too. When today's events are over, let's write the date on that cover together.

tour_yuna_affinity_60.name: Yuna
tour_yuna_affinity_60.text: The last page I'll show you this afternoon... Don't let it be anyone else. You read it first.

tour_dain_affinity_80.name: Dain
tour_dain_affinity_80.text: Next week, when I officially practice match commentary, you have to come watch! Once the date's set, I'll message you first.

tour_dain_affinity_60.name: Dain
tour_dain_affinity_60.text: Want to stop by the broadcast booth together this afternoon? I already decided you're the first listener for my mic test today.

tour_seo_neg.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_neg.text: *Seoyeon never takes the key ring out of her pocket.* For the afternoon route, it's better if we go separately.

tour_yuna_neg.name: Yuna
tour_yuna_neg.text: *From inside, Yuna latches the annex door.* Sorry. Don't follow me in here today.

tour_dain_neg.name: Dain
tour_dain_neg.text: *Dain flips the light switches on the gym wall off, one after another.* Let's skip today's lunch bet. I'm heading in first.

day5_haeun_high_intro.name: Haeun
day5_haeun_high_intro.text: Senior, perfect timing! Could you grab this corner with me? Please help me carry it just as far as the broadcast room. *Haeun holds out one side of the paperwork box she had been holding in both arms.*

day5_haeun_high_clasp.name: Haeun
day5_haeun_high_clasp.text: Ah, senior, please don't move for a second. I think my bracelet clasp caught on your sleeve button. *She sets the box down in front of the broadcast room door, and Haeun leans her head in close to my chest to undo the tangled silver chain. Right then, someone's footsteps in the hallway stop dead beside us.*

day5_haeun_explain_choice.name: {name}
day5_haeun_explain_choice.text: *Startled, Haeun quickly lets go of the bracelet and looks back. In the strangely stiffened air, I speak first.*

day5_haeun_explain_open.name: {name}
day5_haeun_explain_open.text: *I explain calmly that this is Haeun, who helps with student council work, and that while we were carrying a paperwork box to the broadcast room her bracelet clasp caught on my sleeve button and we were undoing it. The gaze from across from us still rests on the ends of our sleeves, where they had been touching.*

day5_haeun_explain_delay.name: {name}
day5_haeun_explain_delay.text: *I ask them to wait a moment, then turn back to finish freeing Haeun's bracelet. To the person stopped in the hallway, I only add that I'll explain separately later.*

day5_haeun_defends.name: Haeun
day5_haeun_defends.text: Um, I asked for the help first. I can speak comfortably to senior. *Haeun pulls the paperwork box on the floor in close to her feet.* We really didn't do anything that could be misunderstood. ...No. Why does it sound even more like a strange excuse now that I've said it myself?

day5_haeun_waver_1.name: Haeun
day5_haeun_waver_1.text: *After the moment has passed, Haeun looks down at her empty palms, then fidgets with the bracelet clasp on her wrist for a long while.* Senior, I said earlier that it was nothing. That's clearly true, but... what I said before, that I was rooting for the two of you, keeps catching in my throat. I'm just going to keep pretending I don't notice, and swallow it.

day5_haeun_waver_choice.name: Haeun
day5_haeun_waver_choice.text: *Haeun clenches her fist and slowly opens it, over and over, forcing a smile.* I'm fine. It's really nothing. ...It really is nothing, but what are you thinking right now, senior?
choices: You don't have to pretend you're fine.
Stay beside her without a word

day5_haeun_waver_up.name: Haeun
day5_haeun_waver_up.text: *Haeun lets out the breath she was holding and drops the tension from her shoulders.* ...Thank you, senior. Hearing you say that, I'm a little less scared. Please stay beside me just a little longer.

day5_haeun_waver_down.name: Haeun
day5_haeun_waver_down.text: *With fingertips gone cold, Haeun presses hard on the bracelet clasp, then lets go.* ...Okay. I'll just treat what I said a moment ago as nothing.

day5_haeun_finish.name: Haeun
day5_haeun_finish.text: Thank you for taking this paperwork box! *Haeun hands the box to the student in charge of the broadcast club and clicks the undone bracelet clasp shut again. From the speaker overhead, the lunch event announcement plays.*

day5_haeun_low_intro.name: Haeun
day5_haeun_low_intro.text: Are you looking for the booth checklist? *Haeun draws the file a little closer and holds it against herself.* I'm sorry, but I'm still a little hesitant to leave it to you alone, senior.

day5_haeun_low_choice.name: Haeun
day5_haeun_low_choice.text: We just need to cross-check the afternoon booth numbers and the emergency route locations again. If you really mean to help, walk around with me and check them.
choices: Apologize for earlier and help with the inspection
Leave the task to Haeun and go

day5_haeun_low_apology.name: Haeun
day5_haeun_low_apology.text: *I apologize politely for the attitude that made her uncomfortable last time we talked, and say I'll help finish the inspection. Haeun studies my eyes for a moment, then carefully opens the checklist.* ...I heard your apology. Then please check this section with me, starting here.

day5_haeun_low_work.name: {name}
day5_haeun_low_work.text: Every booth number matches, through the last one. I moved the empty boxes blocking the aisle over to the wall, and I wrote where the missing signs go in the margin here. *I hand Haeun the checklist once the checks are done.*

day5_haeun_low_repair.name: Haeun
day5_haeun_low_repair.text: *Haeun turns through the filled-in checklist, page by page.* You didn't cut corners. You looked through all of it to the end. Honestly, what happened last time still bothers me a little, but I'm really grateful you went out of your way to help today.

day5_haeun_low_thanks.name: Haeun
day5_haeun_low_thanks.text: *Haeun draws a circle in the last box on the checklist.* Thanks to you, senior, we finished much earlier than I expected. I'll take the rest of the paperwork to the student council room.

day5_haeun_low_leave.name: Haeun
day5_haeun_low_leave.text: Yes, I understand. I'll finish checking the remaining sections on my own. *Haeun folds the checklist in half and walks briskly toward the booths.*

day5_haeun_seoyeon_arrival.name: Seoyeon
day5_haeun_seoyeon_arrival.text: So you two were here. *Coming down the hall, Seoyeon stops and looks down, from Haeun's fingertips to my shirt sleeve and back.* ...What were you doing here?

day5_haeun_seoyeon_escalation.name: Seoyeon
day5_haeun_seoyeon_escalation.text: So you're close enough that she can ask you freely. *Seoyeon turns toward me, her eyes calm but cold.* Don't let Haeun speak for you. Say it yourself. Since when have you two been this close?

day5_haeun_seoyeon_escalation_delay.name: Seoyeon
day5_haeun_seoyeon_escalation_delay.text: So you're close enough that she can ask you freely. *Seoyeon turns toward me, her eyes calm but cold.* Don't let Haeun speak for you. Say it yourself. Since when have you two been this close?

day5_haeun_seoyeon_group_talk.name: Seoyeon · Haeun
day5_haeun_seoyeon_group_talk.text: *Haeun steps half a pace back with a troubled face, and Seoyeon waits for my answer, her gaze steady.*

Haeun defended him, saying she felt comfortable asking him for help, which deepened the misunderstanding about their relationship. The other person has already lost 15 affinity, or 20 if the protagonist delayed explaining. There has been no romance or sexual activity between Haeun and the protagonist.

Score Haeun’s affinity just like a personal conversation: a sincere explanation that does not shift blame onto Haeun earns +2, and concretely caring for Haeun’s awkward position or worry after defending the protagonist earns up to +3.

groupChoiceState.delay: The protagonist asked the other person to wait, turned back to Haeun and put off explaining. They took this as avoidance. The initial penalty for this choice has already been applied.

day5_haeun_yuna_arrival.name: Yuna
day5_haeun_yuna_arrival.text: ...Wait. *Passing in the hall, Yuna slowly pulls out one earbud and looks at the narrow space between us.* You two were standing really close.

day5_haeun_yuna_escalation.name: Yuna
day5_haeun_yuna_escalation.text: *Yuna coils the earbud cord and tucks it into her uniform pocket.* I get that you helped move the paperwork. But I've never seen the two of you get this close. ...I want to hear it from you, too.

day5_haeun_yuna_escalation_delay.name: Yuna
day5_haeun_yuna_escalation_delay.text: *Yuna coils the earbud cord and tucks it into her uniform pocket.* I know Haeun asked you first. Still, tell me yourself. What were you two just doing?

day5_haeun_yuna_group_talk.name: Yuna · Haeun
day5_haeun_yuna_group_talk.text: *Haeun carefully steps half a pace back, and Yuna looks at the corner of my mouth with quiet eyes.*
